title: Introduce session-stitcher and compact stream facade across SDKs
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Introduces a lightweight session-stitcher (auth orchestration) and a compact stream facade across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs; harmonizes retry preset names and bumps SDK minor versions. No breaking API changes; adds integration tests and docs updates.
description:
Context: Multiple SDKs implemented similar ad-hoc auth handoffs for long-lived streams which caused duplication and subtle bugs around token refresh timing and callback ordering. Motivation: provide a small, explicit abstraction (session-stitcher) that centralizes token handoff and a companion compact stream facade that gives ergonomic async iterables/pullstreams across languages while keeping per-call surface minimal. This PR implements the stitcher in Python/TS/Go, wires it into existing streaming clients, harmonizes retry preset names across SDKs, and performs a coordinated minor version bump for each SDK.

What changed (high-level): commits: 1) introduce session-stitcher abstraction and core interfaces (py/ts/go) 2) implement compact stream facade backed by existing transport layers 3) update retry presets and documentation 4) add cross-sdk integration tests and e2e CI pipeline job 5) version bumps and changelog entries.

Files touched: key files listed above include small, targeted changes in each SDK and docs; most SDK changes are adapter layers and isolated helpers, not public surface breakages.

Compatibility notes: default runtime behavior is unchanged. The stitcher is opt-in via a new client option (session_stitcher: true by default in next minor), and the compact stream facade is a convenience wrapper that delegates to the existing streaming transport. Existing call sites continue to work. If teams rely on custom auth callback ordering, they should validate with the new tests; an escape hatch (raw transport) remains.

Testing and CI: added unit and integration tests in each SDK and a dedicated e2e job that runs Python/TS/Go flow end-to-end against the test harness. Initial CI run failed on a flaky TS test (stream timeout) — fixed by adding a small prefetch/backoff in the facade and rerunning. Final CI status: pass.

Review summary: initial review raised three areas: tighter test coverage for token-race, clearer docs for opt-in semantics, and a suggestion to consolidate retry preset names into the common presets.yaml. Actions: added deterministic token-race test in Python, expanded the docs with a migration note and examples, and applied consolidated names in presets.yaml.

Commits summary (high-level):
- 7f3b1a4: add session-stitcher core interfaces and basic TS impl
- b2d4c2e: python session_stitcher implementation + tests
- d9e8a77: go stitcher + facade + go integration test harness updates
- c1a9f00: compact stream facade for TS; add async generator helpers
- e2f4e11: harmonize retry presets; update CI e2e job; changelogs and version bumps

Review conversation (high-level single-string log): Reviewer Lucas Patel: "Nice consolidation — please add deterministic test for token races and ensure we don't regress streaming latency with prefetch." Author (Maya Chen): "Added deterministic token-race test in Python and measured latency: <2ms median overhead in our microbench. TS facade gets a configurable prefetch default=1. See tests/integration and perf notes in docs." Reviewer Rohit Sharma: "Can we keep retry preset identifiers stable for backwards compatibility?" Author: "We kept legacy aliases and added migration mapping in presets.yaml; SDKs will accept both names for the next minor and emit a deprecation notice in logs." Reviewer Ava Morgan: "Docs look good; please add Quickstart snippet for session stitcher." Author: "Added example under examples/ and a one‑paragraph migration note in docs/sdk/streaming.md." Approvals: Lucas + Ava approved after fixes; Rohit gave final approval post migration mapping.

CI details: initial job matrix (py/ts/go) - python unit/integration: pass; ts unit: pass; ts integration: fail (timeout) fixed by prefetch tweak; go tests: pass; linters: pass; security scan: pass. Reran failing TS job -> pass.

Merge notes: squashed commits, updated changelogs and bumped SDK minor versions (python 1.12.0 -> 1.13.0, typescript 1.27.0 -> 1.28.0, go 1.8.2 -> 1.9.0). No migration required for most users, deprecation aliases in place. Merged on 2026-02-26 using squash.

Follow-ups: track ENG-1422 to remove legacy preset aliases in next major; ENG-1479 to add additional telemetry hooks to session-stitcher (opt-in).
notes_for_release_manager: Coordinated minor bumps across SDKs — ensure packaged artifacts for Python/TS/Go are published together. Inform platform integrators of deprecation aliases (presets) and the upcoming removal in next major.
changelog_entry: Added session-stitcher (auth orchestration) and compact stream facade; harmonized retry preset names; bumped SDK minor versions; added integration tests and docs.
